sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_on_promo_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`promotional_rate_flag` = TRUE

SELECT
  `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` AS `service_tier`,
  ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(CAST(`churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` AS DATE), `subscription`.`activation_date`)), 1) AS `average_days_on_last_plan`,
  COUNT(*) AS `cancellations`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `subscription_plan`.`service_tier`
ORDER BY `average_days_on_last_plan` DESC

WITH `cancelled_accounts` AS (
  SELECT
    `churn_event`.`churn_event_id`,
    `churn_event`.`subscriber_id`,
    `churn_event`.`subscription_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
),
`failed_payment_accounts` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `invoice`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `payment`
    ON `payment`.`invoice_id` = `invoice`.`invoice_id`
  WHERE `payment`.`payment_status` = 'Failed'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS `total_cancellations`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `failed_payment_accounts`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `cancellations_with_failed_payment_history`,
  try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `failed_payment_accounts`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0,COUNT(*)) AS `failed_payment_history_share_percent`
FROM `cancelled_accounts`
LEFT JOIN `failed_payment_accounts`
  ON `cancelled_accounts`.`subscriber_id` = `failed_payment_accounts`.`subscriber_id`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `annual_paying_subs_up_for_renewal_next_60_days`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND DATE_ADD(DATE'2026-11-10', 60)

SELECT `viewing_bucket`, `viewing_percent`
FROM (
  SELECT
    '4K' AS `viewing_bucket`,
    try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `video_resolution` = '4K' THEN `total_watch_duration_seconds` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`)) AS `viewing_percent`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `video_resolution` IS NOT NULL
    AND `total_watch_duration_seconds` IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'Rest' AS `viewing_bucket`,
    try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `video_resolution` <> '4K' THEN `total_watch_duration_seconds` ELSE 0 END),SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`)) AS `viewing_percent`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `video_resolution` IS NOT NULL
    AND `total_watch_duration_seconds` IS NOT NULL
) AS `x`

SELECT 'Film' AS content_group,
       try_divide(AVG(title.runtime_seconds), 60.0) AS avg_length_minutes
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
WHERE title.runtime_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND title.content_type IS NOT NULL
  AND title.content_type = 'Film'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Regular series episode' AS content_group,
       try_divide(AVG(content_episode.runtime_seconds), 60.0) AS avg_length_minutes
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
WHERE content_episode.runtime_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND content_episode.content_series_id IS NOT NULL
  AND content_episode.episode_type IS NOT NULL
  AND content_episode.episode_type <> 'Feature'

SELECT
  `series`.`series_status`,
  COUNT(*) AS `series_count`,
  AVG(`series`.`total_season_count`) AS `avg_seasons_per_series`,
  percentile_approx(`series`.`total_season_count`, 0.5) AS `median_seasons_per_series`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
WHERE `series`.`series_status` IS NOT NULL
  AND `series`.`total_season_count` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `series`.`series_status`
ORDER BY `series`.`series_status`

WITH subtitle_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_language`,
    COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subtitle_language`
), ranked_subtitles AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_language`,
    `sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `sessions` DESC) AS `rnk`
  FROM subtitle_counts
)
SELECT
  `subtitle_language`,
  `sessions`
FROM ranked_subtitles
WHERE `rnk` <= 1
ORDER BY `sessions` DESC, `subtitle_language`

SELECT campaign_status, COUNT(*) n, MIN(start_date), MAX(start_date), MIN(end_date), MAX(end_date),
 SUM(CASE WHEN start_date <= DATE'2026-11-10' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE'2026-11-10') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_flight
FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign GROUP BY campaign_status

SELECT c.campaign_type AS objective, COUNT(*) AS live_campaigns,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery d WHERE d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND d.delivery_date = DATE'2026-11-09') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS served_on_2026_11_09
FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign c
WHERE c.campaign_status = 'Live'
GROUP BY c.campaign_type ORDER BY live_campaigns DESC

SELECT `order_type`, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross_contracted_value_usd, ROUND(100*SUM(`total_contracted_value`)/SUM(SUM(`total_contracted_value`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_gross, SUM(`net_order_value`) AS net_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN `order_status`='Cancelled' THEN `total_contracted_value` ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_gross, COUNT(DISTINCT `currency_code`) AS currencies FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY `order_type` ORDER BY gross_contracted_value_usd DESC

SELECT `order_type`, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross_contracted_value_usd, ROUND(100*SUM(`total_contracted_value`)/SUM(SUM(`total_contracted_value`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_gross, SUM(`net_order_value`) AS net_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN `order_status`='Cancelled' THEN `total_contracted_value` ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_gross, COUNT(DISTINCT `currency_code`) AS currencies FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY `order_type` ORDER BY gross_contracted_value_usd DESC

SELECT `order_type`, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross_contracted_value_usd, ROUND(100*SUM(`total_contracted_value`)/SUM(SUM(`total_contracted_value`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_gross, SUM(`net_order_value`) AS net_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN `order_status`='Cancelled' THEN `total_contracted_value` ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_gross, COUNT(DISTINCT `currency_code`) AS currencies FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY `order_type` ORDER BY gross_contracted_value_usd DESC

SELECT `currency_code`, `order_status`, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross, MIN(`total_contracted_value`) AS min_v, MAX(`total_contracted_value`) AS max_v, AVG(`contracted_cpm`) AS avg_cpm FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT `order_type`, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross_contracted_value_usd, ROUND(100*SUM(`total_contracted_value`)/SUM(SUM(`total_contracted_value`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_gross, SUM(`net_order_value`) AS net_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN `order_status`='Cancelled' THEN `total_contracted_value` ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_gross, COUNT(DISTINCT `currency_code`) AS currencies FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY `order_type` ORDER BY gross_contracted_value_usd DESC

SELECT `currency_code`, `order_status`, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross, MIN(`total_contracted_value`) AS min_v, MAX(`total_contracted_value`) AS max_v, AVG(`contracted_cpm`) AS avg_cpm FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT `order_type`, COUNT(*) AS order_lines, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross_contracted_value_usd, ROUND(100*SUM(`total_contracted_value`)/SUM(SUM(`total_contracted_value`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_gross, SUM(`net_order_value`) AS net_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN `order_status`='Cancelled' THEN `total_contracted_value` ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_gross, COUNT(DISTINCT `currency_code`) AS currencies FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY `order_type` ORDER BY gross_contracted_value_usd DESC

SELECT `currency_code`, `order_status`, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(`total_contracted_value`) AS gross, MIN(`total_contracted_value`) AS min_v, MAX(`total_contracted_value`) AS max_v, AVG(`contracted_cpm`) AS avg_cpm FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`ad_order` GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.`strategic_tier`,'(none)') AS strategic_tier, d.`currency_code`,
 COUNT(DISTINCT p.`partner_id`) AS partners, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS deals,
 SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`) AS total_deal_value,
 SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_status`='Active' THEN d.`deal_value_amount` END) AS active_deal_value,
 ROUND(100*SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)/SUM(SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_value
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`acquisition_deal` d
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`partner` p ON d.`partner_id`=p.`partner_id`
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.`strategic_tier`,'(none)') AS strategic_tier, d.`currency_code`, COUNT(DISTINCT p.`partner_id`) AS partners, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS deals, SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`) AS total_deal_value, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_status`='Active' THEN d.`deal_value_amount` END) AS active_deal_value, ROUND(100*SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)/SUM(SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_value FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`acquisition_deal` d LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`partner` p ON d.`partner_id`=p.`partner_id` GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.`strategic_tier`,'(none)') AS strategic_tier, d.`currency_code`,
 COUNT(DISTINCT p.`partner_id`) AS partners, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS deals,
 SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`) AS total_deal_value,
 SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_status`='Active' THEN d.`deal_value_amount` END) AS active_deal_value,
 ROUND(100*SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)/SUM(SUM(d.`deal_value_amount`)) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_value
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`acquisition_deal` d
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_partner`.`partner` p ON d.`partner_id`=p.`partner_id`
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

SELECT d.`deal_status`, d.`exclusivity_flag`, COUNT(*) n, MIN(d.`deal_expiration_date`) min_exp, MAX(d.`deal_expiration_date`) max_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_expiration_date` < DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) past_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_effective_date` > DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_start
FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT `partner_type`, COUNT(*) n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT d.`deal_status`, d.`exclusivity_flag`, COUNT(*) n, MIN(d.`deal_expiration_date`) min_exp, MAX(d.`deal_expiration_date`) max_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_expiration_date` < DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) past_exp, SUM(CASE WHEN d.`deal_effective_date` > DATE'2026-11-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_start FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT `partner_type`, COUNT(*) n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT p.`partner_type`, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`acquisition_deal_id`) AS active_exclusive_deals, COUNT(DISTINCT d.`partner_id`) AS partners FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner p ON d.`partner_id` = p.`partner_id` WHERE d.`exclusivity_flag` = true AND d.`deal_status` = 'Active' GROUP BY ROLLUP(p.`partner_type`) ORDER BY p.`partner_type` IS NULL, active_exclusive_deals DESC

WITH ce AS ( SELECT c.churn_event_id, c.subscriber_id, c.last_viewed_title_id, CAST(c.churn_timestamp AS DATE) AS churn_date, s.territory_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.churn_event c JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber s ON s.subscriber_id = c.subscriber_id ), flags AS ( SELECT ce.*, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id AND w.active_flag = true) AS live_now, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id AND w.window_open_date <= ce.churn_date AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= ce.churn_date)) AS live_at_churn, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id) AS any_window FROM ce ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS churn_events, COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS cancelled_subscribers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NULL THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_null_last_title, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_now THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_active_window_now, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_at_churn THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_window_at_churn, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT any_window THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_window_ever, SUM(CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_now THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_no_active_now, SUM(CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_at_churn THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_no_window_at_churn FROM flags

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT s.`subscriber_id`, MAX(CASE WHEN p.`plan_type`='Paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_paid, COUNT(*) AS n_active
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` s
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` p ON s.`subscription_plan_id`=p.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE s.`subscription_status`='Active'
  GROUP BY s.`subscriber_id`
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c.`subscriber_id` IS NULL THEN 'No active plan (cancelled)' WHEN c.is_paid=1 THEN 'Paid plan now' ELSE 'Free plan now' END AS current_plan,
  COUNT(*) AS impressions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS viewers,
  MAX(c.n_active) AS max_active_rows
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN cur c ON i.`subscriber_id`=c.`subscriber_id`
WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY impressions DESC

WITH cur AS ( SELECT s.`subscriber_id`, MAX(CASE WHEN p.`plan_type`='Paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_paid, COUNT(*) AS n_active FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` s JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` p ON s.`subscription_plan_id`=p.`subscription_plan_id` WHERE s.`subscription_status`='Active' GROUP BY s.`subscriber_id` ) SELECT CASE WHEN c.`subscriber_id` IS NULL THEN 'No active plan (cancelled)' WHEN c.is_paid=1 THEN 'Paid plan now' ELSE 'Free plan now' END AS current_plan, COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS viewers, MAX(c.n_active) AS max_active_rows FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i LEFT JOIN cur c ON i.`subscriber_id`=c.`subscriber_id` WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY impressions DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`content_type`, 'Unmatched') AS content_type,
       i.`currency_code`,
       COUNT(*) AS impressions,
       ROUND(SUM(i.`cpm_realized`) / 1000, 2) AS ad_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(AVG(i.`cpm_realized`), 2) AS avg_cpm,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(i.`cpm_realized`) / SUM(SUM(i.`cpm_realized`)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON i.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id`
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id`
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY ad_revenue_usd DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`content_type`, 'Unmatched') AS content_type, i.`currency_code`, COUNT(*) AS impressions, ROUND(SUM(i.`cpm_realized`) / 1000, 2) AS ad_revenue_usd, ROUND(AVG(i.`cpm_realized`), 2) AS avg_cpm, ROUND(100 * SUM(i.`cpm_realized`) / SUM(SUM(i.`cpm_realized`)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON i.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id` LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id` GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY ad_revenue_usd DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`content_type`, 'Unmatched') AS content_type,
       i.`currency_code`,
       COUNT(*) AS impressions,
       ROUND(SUM(i.`cpm_realized`) / 1000, 2) AS ad_revenue_usd,
       ROUND(AVG(i.`cpm_realized`), 2) AS avg_cpm,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(i.`cpm_realized`) / SUM(SUM(i.`cpm_realized`)) OVER (), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON i.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id`
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id`
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY ad_revenue_usd DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`territory_group`, 'Unmatched') AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS ad_viewers,
  COUNT(*) AS impressions
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` s ON i.`subscriber_id` = s.`subscriber_id`
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` t ON s.`territory_id` = t.`territory_id`
WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total (all regions)', COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`), COUNT(*)
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery`
WHERE `delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND `delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
ORDER BY ad_viewers DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`territory_group`, 'Unmatched') AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS ad_viewers, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` s ON i.`subscriber_id` = s.`subscriber_id` LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` t ON s.`territory_id` = t.`territory_id` WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'Total (all regions)', COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`), COUNT(*) FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` WHERE `delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND `delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01' ORDER BY ad_viewers DESC

SELECT COALESCE(t.`territory_group`, 'Unmatched') AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.`subscriber_id`) AS ad_viewers,
  COUNT(*) AS impressions
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` s ON i.`subscriber_id` = s.`subscriber_id`
LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` t ON s.`territory_id` = t.`territory_id`
WHERE i.`delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND i.`delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total (all regions)', COUNT(DISTINCT `subscriber_id`), COUNT(*)
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery`
WHERE `delivery_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01' AND `delivery_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
ORDER BY ad_viewers DESC

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`subtotal_amount` - `discount_amount`) AS `monthly_revenue`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice`
  WHERE `invoice_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `invoice_date` < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATE'2026-11-10')

WITH f AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(g.`name`,'(unmatched)') AS genre, i.`viewable_impressions`, i.`cpm_realized`,
         CASE WHEN s.`genre_id` IS NOT NULL AND s.`genre_id` <> t.`genre_id` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS genre_mismatch
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_sales`.`impression_delivery` i
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` e ON i.`content_episode_id` = e.`content_episode_id`
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` t ON e.`title_id` = t.`title_id`
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` s ON t.`series_id` = s.`series_id`
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`genre` g ON t.`genre_id` = g.`genre_id`
), agg AS (
  SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(`viewable_impressions`) AS viewable_impressions,
         ROUND(SUM(`cpm_realized`)/1000,2) AS ad_revenue_usd, SUM(genre_mismatch) AS series_genre_mismatch_rows
  FROM f GROUP BY genre
)
SELECT genre, impressions, ROUND(100*impressions/SUM(impressions) OVER (),1) AS pct_of_all_impressions,
       viewable_impressions, ad_revenue_usd, series_genre_mismatch_rows,
       SUM(impressions) OVER () AS total_impressions, COUNT(*) OVER () AS genre_count
FROM agg ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 10

WITH `plan_switches` AS (
  SELECT
    `old_sub`.`subscription_id` AS `old_subscription_id`,
    `new_sub`.`subscription_id` AS `new_subscription_id`,
    `old_plan`.`base_price` AS `old_base_price`,
    `new_plan`.`base_price` AS `new_base_price`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `old_sub`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `new_sub`
    ON `old_sub`.`subscriber_id` = `new_sub`.`subscriber_id`
   AND `old_sub`.`termination_date` = `new_sub`.`activation_date`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `old_plan`
    ON `old_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` = `old_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `new_plan`
    ON `new_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` = `new_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `old_sub`.`subscription_status` = 'Superseded'
    AND `old_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `new_sub`.`subscription_plan_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `old_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `new_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `old_plan`.`base_price` IS NOT NULL
    AND `new_plan`.`base_price` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS `paid_to_paid_switches`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `new_base_price` < `old_base_price` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `downgrade_switches`,
  try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `new_base_price` < `old_base_price` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS `downgrade_share_percent`
FROM `plan_switches`

WITH `reason_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` AS `cancellation_reason`,
    COUNT(*) AS `cancellations`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= add_months(DATE'2026-11-10', -12)
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < DATE'2026-11-10'
    AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
    AND `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`, `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description`
), `ranked` AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `cancellation_reason`,
    `cancellations`,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY `region` ORDER BY `cancellations` DESC, `cancellation_reason` ASC) AS `reason_rank`
  FROM `reason_counts`
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `cancellation_reason`,
  `cancellations`
FROM `ranked`
WHERE `reason_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `region`, `cancellation_reason`;

WITH monthly_refunds AS (

    AND `processing_date` < ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10'), 12)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`)
), running_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `monthly_processed_refund_amount`,
    SUM(`monthly_processed_refund_amount`) OVER (ORDER BY `month` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `running_total_amount`

FROM running_refunds

WITH `studio_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `series`.`production_company` AS `studio`,
    COUNT(*) AS `series_count`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `series`.`finale_date` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `still_airing_series_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
  WHERE `series`.`production_company` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `series`.`production_company`
), `ranked_studios` AS (
  SELECT
    `studio`,
    `series_count`,
    `still_airing_series_count`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `series_count` DESC) AS `studio_rank`
  FROM `studio_counts`
)
SELECT
  `studio`,
  `series_count`,
  `still_airing_series_count`
FROM `ranked_studios`
WHERE `studio_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `series_count` DESC, `studio` ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active' AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid' THEN `subscription`.`subscriber_id` END) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
